description: Na₄MoS₃O₁₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MoO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with five SO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 69°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.78 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MoO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with three SO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.59 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.78 Å. Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MoO₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids and corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-2.24 Å. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MoO₆ octahedra and corners with three NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-53°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.52 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MoO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 41°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.55 Å. In the third S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MoO₆ octahedra and corners with three NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 47°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.58 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Mo and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one S atom.
